result.question: What does the old prophet do with the body?

readings.answer: He laid the body in his own tomb.
readings.support: he laid the body in his own tomb

assessments.reason: The phrase “he laid the body in his own tomb” directly matches “buried him in his grave,” with “own tomb” = “his grave” and laying the body constituting burial (v.30).
“After he had buried him” (v.31) confirms the act of burial; it omits the location but still answers what he did with the body.
